epics.sixSigmaMetric: Number of unresolved audit findings affecting core product authentication
requirements: R1: Fix authentication vulnerability in AuthController by properly detecting LMS server errors rather than unconditionally skipping verification, ensuring failed auth returns 401 instead of a fallback backdoor.
R2: Fix HTTP 401 errors on dossier endpoints (e.g. EmployeeDossierControllerTest) for authenticated requests so that the core product is usable.
R3: Explicitly define safe error handling patterns (400, 401, 403, or error) for authentication and dossier operations to satisfy security policies.

slices.title: Fix SSO auth vulnerabilities and dossier endpoint authorization
slices.jtbd: When resolving the audit findings for this epic, I want to properly secure both the fallback auth path and dossier endpoints while documenting error states, so that the authentication system functions correctly without bypassing security.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a login request with an invalid SSO token when the SSO server is healthy,
When AuthController.ssoLogin processes the request,
Then it returns a 401 Unauthorized status and does not use the fallback password.

Given an authenticated request to a dossier endpoint,
When the endpoint is accessed,
Then it correctly authorizes the user and returns the expected resource (200 OK) rather than a 401.

Given the need for explicit error handling definition,
When the task is completed,
Then the definition of done explicitly handles and documents 400, 401, 403, and server error scenarios.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Correctly validating LMS errors and dossier authorization
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Percentage of security tests passing without fallback bypass or false 401s
